data.description:
## Goal
Write tests/scripts/test-spec-fidelity-check.sh before the script exists (RED). Tests cover PIL field mutation detection vs story done-definitions.

## Test Cases
1. PIL field exactly matches story DD text -> exits 0
2. PIL field dropped (absent in story DDs) -> exits 1 with diff {dropped_field, pil_value}
3. PIL field paraphrased (semantic change) -> exits 1 with diff {field, pil_text, dd_text}
4. PIL field mutated (different value) -> exits 1 with diff
5. Story has additional DDs not in PIL (enrichment) -> exits 0 (enrichment permitted)
6. All PIL fields present and matched -> exits 0

## Acceptance Criteria
- bash tests/scripts/test-spec-fidelity-check.sh exits non-zero (RED)
- chmod +x tests/scripts/test-spec-fidelity-check.sh

## Testing Mode
RED
data.title: T1: RED — Write test suite for spec-fidelity-check.sh
